# Inline-four engine block concept; dimensions are arbitrary millimetre-like units.
# Main crankcase, lower mounting flange, and raised cylinder deck.
box block -60 -34 5 120 68 48
box flange -64 -40 0 128 80 8
union block block flange
box deck -61 -37 49 122 74 6
union block block deck
# Four cylinder bores break through the deck and meet the crank chamber.
cylinder bore_1 -42 0 15 10.5 42
subtract block block bore_1
cylinder bore_2 -14 0 15 10.5 42
subtract block block bore_2
cylinder bore_3 14 0 15 10.5 42
subtract block block bore_3
cylinder bore_4 42 0 15 10.5 42
subtract block block bore_4
# Longitudinal crankshaft gallery, open on both end faces.
cylinder crank_tunnel -66 0 18 13 132 1 0 0
subtract block block crank_tunnel
# Eight head-stud wells in the deck.
cylinder stud_1 -42 -27 29 2.5 28
subtract block block stud_1
cylinder stud_2 -14 -27 29 2.5 28
subtract block block stud_2
cylinder stud_3 14 -27 29 2.5 28
subtract block block stud_3
cylinder stud_4 42 -27 29 2.5 28
subtract block block stud_4
cylinder stud_5 -42 27 29 2.5 28
subtract block block stud_5
cylinder stud_6 -14 27 29 2.5 28
subtract block block stud_6
cylinder stud_7 14 27 29 2.5 28
subtract block block stud_7
cylinder stud_8 42 27 29 2.5 28
subtract block block stud_8
# Four side ports connect the front wall to the cylinder bores.
cylinder port_1 -42 -39 37 4.7 36 0 1 0
subtract block block port_1
cylinder port_2 -14 -39 37 4.7 36 0 1 0
subtract block block port_2
cylinder port_3 14 -39 37 4.7 36 0 1 0
subtract block block port_3
cylinder port_4 42 -39 37 4.7 36 0 1 0
subtract block block port_4
# Through bolts in the four flange corners.
cylinder mount_1 -56 -32 -1 3.2 10
subtract block block mount_1
cylinder mount_2 -56 32 -1 3.2 10
subtract block block mount_2
cylinder mount_3 56 -32 -1 3.2 10
subtract block block mount_3
cylinder mount_4 56 32 -1 3.2 10
subtract block block mount_4
material block 0.37 0.43 0.48 0.78 0.42
# Separate end cover and a simple stepped crank nose give readable scale.
cylinder end_cover 60 0 18 18 3 1 0 0
cylinder cover_opening 59 0 18 12.8 5 1 0 0
subtract end_cover end_cover cover_opening
material end_cover 0.16 0.19 0.23 0.75 0.36
cylinder crank_nose 60 0 18 8 14 1 0 0
material crank_nose 0.70 0.72 0.67 0.88 0.28
cylinder nose_flange 72 0 18 10.5 3 1 0 0
material nose_flange 0.70 0.72 0.67 0.88 0.28
